title: PixelKin - Wild Battle (r2 remaster pilot)
_note: R2 REMASTER PILOT (parallel to battle-main-dusk-duel; NOT wired into the game). Panel brief: docs/reviews/music-remaster-panel.md. 160 BPM, 4/4, E minor (moved off the title's A minor so the fight has its own colour) with a B7 harmonic-minor dominant, lifting to the relative G major. Form A(8) A'(8) B(8) = 24 bars, ~36 s. HOOK (bars 1-2): the Lantern Call turned fighter - B4-E5-F#5 (sol-do-re of E minor) launched on two eighths and a syncopated dotted hold, then a stabbing fall to B4 and a bar of SPACE that the brass answers (call-and-response). The hook sequences up a third (C) and to D, climbs to C6 over bVI, and cadences on a B7 leading tone. B: the leitmotif in heroic MAJOR (D5-G5-A5 over G) with a twin lead in thirds and sustained brass, climbing to D6, then a B7 run (D#) slams the loop back to E minor. Bass: octave-pumping eighth gallop with chromatic approach into every change. Arp: 16th pulse12 enters at bar 5 (dynamics by entry). Drums: backbeat with a pushed kick on the and-of-3; four-on-the-floor + open hat in B; fills on every 8-bar seam. Dry - battles keep the echo off so the hits punch. <=8 voices. Original melody throughout (VISION.md).
key: E minor (harmonic-minor dominant) -> G major lift

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: The hook: B4-E5-F#5 (Lantern lift) then the gap the brass fills. B section: the lift in MAJOR (D5-G5-A5).

tracks.name: harm
tracks._note: B only: a twin line a third/sixth below the lead - the heroic payoff.

tracks.name: brass
tracks._note: A: alternating call (hit + syncopated push) and response (stabs in the lead's rests). B: sustained heroic chords.

tracks.name: arp
tracks._note: 16th-note chip arpeggio from bar 5; wider sweep in B.

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: Octave-pumping gallop (R R R8 R R R8 5 approach) - the engine of the fight.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: A: backbeat + pushed kick; B: four-on-floor + open hat; tom/snare fills at 8, 16, 24.
